Launch.intro: Find practical help for your account, Japanese learning and Japan preparation. Some services require additional configuration.
answers: Use password reset from the login page. Email confirmation and recovery depend on the configured authentication email service. Never share your password or verification code with support.
Published courses contain the available lessons. Demonstrations and unfinished features are labeled. Save progress by signing in; draft or restricted content is not publicly available.
Reviewed practice is graded by the server. Full mocks and listening sections may remain unavailable. Report a question using its page and general issue, without copying private examination answers.
Live AI needs an enabled provider and usage allowance. Demonstration conversations are labeled. Do not submit private workplace, medical, financial or immigration documents.

Live payments are disabled. Test checkout appears only for configured test providers and prices. Stripe subscriptions renew automatically; Nepal wallet passes require manual renewal. A return page alone does not confirm payment.

Launch.legalIntro: NihonPath is an independent Japanese learning and Japan preparation platform for a worldwide community. It does not claim affiliation with examination authorities or provide immigration eligibility decisions.
Launch.legalPrivacy: Account identifiers, learning progress, organization memberships, tutoring records, payment verification records and support requests are processed for their stated functions. Private transcripts and payment secrets are excluded from analytics. Optional browser analytics requires consent; essential aggregate operational counts are separate. Retention, data-request handling, processor agreements and international transfers require owner review before launch.
Launch.legalTerms: Use only accounts and content you are authorized to access. Course completion is not an official examination certificate or a promise of employment, visa approval or professional qualification. Features under development remain labeled. The operating entity, governing terms, age rules, support contact and dispute process must be supplied and approved before commercial use.
Launch.legalRefund: No real charges are enabled. In test mode, verified full or partial refunds and disputes revoke access from the affected order; other valid purchases retain their own periods. Production eligibility, deadlines, statutory rights, fees and provider-specific refund procedures require review and publication before real purchases.
Launch.legalCancellation: Stripe test cancellation stops future renewal at the configured period end. Nepal wallet passes expire without automatic renewal. Tutor cancellation follows the booking workflow. Cancellation is distinct from refund eligibility; no live cancellation fee or refund promise is established here.
Launch.legalSubscription: Monthly and annual Stripe plans renew automatically where configured. One-time 30-day and 365-day wallet passes renew manually. Access requires backend payment verification and ends according to the paid period. Failed payments do not extend access. Actual recurring prices, taxes, notices, renewal consent and mandatory consumer rights require approval.
Launch.legalProviders: Stripe, eSewa and Khalti integration code is restricted to test environments. Unconfigured methods are hidden. NihonPath does not collect card or wallet passwords. Provider onboarding, settlement eligibility, commercial terms, tax invoices and privacy agreements remain prerequisites to a live service.
Launch.legalCommercial: No operating company name, registration number, business address, tax identifier, commercial telephone number or authorized representative has been supplied. These details must be verified and published where applicable before any public commercial launch.
